param.color_kmeans.export_lab.label: Export CIELab
param.color_kmeans.export_lab.tip:
Include CIELab values (L*, a*, b*) in results.
CIELab is perceptually uniform — ideal to compare colors.
param.color_kmeans.export_luminance.tip:
Perceptual luminance: 0.2126·R + 0.7152·G + 0.0722·B.
High values = light colors, low values = dark colors.
param.color_kmeans.export_pct.label: Export area %
param.color_kmeans.export_pct.tip:
Include the percentage of pixels each color takes
out of all detected object pixels.
param.color_kmeans.export_rgb.label: Export RGB
param.color_kmeans.export_rgb.tip: Include RGB values (0-255) in results and legend.
param.color_kmeans.legend_scale.label: Legend size (1-5)
param.color_kmeans.legend_scale.tip:
Controls the size of the legend box on the image.
1 = very small, 5 = large and readable.
Adjust it to the resolution of your images.
param.color_kmeans.n_colors.label: Number of colors (clusters)
param.color_kmeans.n_colors.tip:
Number of color groups to detect (KMeans clusters).
More clusters = more detail, more computing time.
For bean seeds 2-4 is recommended.
param.morphometry.ancho_max.label: Maximum width (px)
param.morphometry.ancho_max.tip: Maximum allowed width. Keep it high if you don't need to filter.
param.morphometry.ancho_min.label: Minimum width (px)
param.morphometry.ancho_min.tip:
Minimum width of each object's bounding rectangle.
Filters out very thin objects (lines, artifacts).
param.morphometry.ar_max.label: Max. length/width ratio
param.morphometry.ar_max.tip:
Filters out very elongated objects (length/width ratio).
Bean seeds are typically < 3.0.
Lower it to exclude stems or thin roots.
param.morphometry.area_max.label: Maximum area (px²)
param.morphometry.area_max.tip:
Objects with an area above this value are ignored.
Useful to exclude the tray or large artifacts.
Keep it high if there is no large noise.
param.morphometry.area_min.label: Minimum area (px²)
param.morphometry.area_min.tip:
Objects with an area below this value are ignored.
Increase it to filter out small background noise.
Example: if your seeds are ~5000 px², 1000 is a safe value.
param.morphometry.largo_max.label: Maximum length (px)
param.morphometry.largo_min.label: Minimum length (px)
param.morphometry.largo_min.tip: Minimum length of the bounding rectangle.
param.objects.area_max.label: Maximum area ({unit})
param.objects.area_max.tip:
Larger objects are ignored.
In mm² when there is a scale; otherwise in px².
param.objects.area_min.label: Minimum area ({unit})
param.objects.area_min.tip:
Smaller objects are ignored (dust, debris).
In mm² when there is a scale; otherwise in px².
param.objects.auto_threshold.label: Automatic threshold (Otsu)
param.objects.auto_threshold.tip: Computes the threshold on the chosen channel instead of the manual range.
param.objects.exclude_border.label: Exclude border objects
param.objects.exclude_border.tip: Ignores objects cut by the image border.
param.objects.harmonics.label: Harmonics
param.objects.measure_color.label: Color
param.objects.measure_color.tip: Mean color and dominant colors (KMeans) per object and per image.
param.objects.measure_shape.label: Shape
param.objects.measure_shape.tip:
Elliptic Fourier descriptors of each object: the outline without size or rotation,
to compare shapes and compute the mean shape.
param.objects.measure_size.label: Morphometry
param.objects.measure_size.tip:
Size and shape of each object: area, length, width, perimeter, circularity, solidity, etc.
Objects that touched others are counted but not measured.
param.objects.n_colors.label: Colors per object
param.objects.touching.label: Objects touch each other
param.objects.touching.tip:
Turn on if objects touch: they are declumped.
Leave off for separate or irregular objects (flowers, leaves).
param.seed_counter.min_distance.label: Minimum distance between seeds (px)
param.seed_counter.min_distance.tip:
Minimum distance in pixels between two detected seed centers.
Lower it if seeds are very close together.
Raise it if a seed is being counted twice.
param.seed_counter.peak_threshold.label: Peak threshold (fraction)
param.seed_counter.peak_threshold.tip:
Fraction of the maximum of the distance transform.
Only peaks above this percentage of the maximum are detected.
Raise it to detect only large seeds; lower it to include small ones.
param.seed_counter.scale_factor.label: Reduction factor
param.seed_counter.scale_factor.tip:
The image is reduced to 1/N to speed up processing.
Factor 4 = image at 25% of its original size.
Use 1 for maximum precision (slower with large images).
param.seed_counter.threshold_val.label: Cr channel threshold
param.seed_counter.threshold_val.tip:
Threshold on the Cr channel of YCrCb to separate seeds from the background.
Bean seeds usually have Cr > 125.
Lower it if few seeds are detected; raise it if there are false positives.
